description:
• Work as a team member in the support and development of agency business applications developed using Visual Basic 6, C#, VB.Net, Classic ASP and ASP.Net
 • Collaborate within a team environment to validate design concepts and define project-specific technical requirements
 • Create and maintain detailed documentation including business requirements, analysis, test case scenarios, and migration procedures
 


 • Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology required
 • 5 or more years' practical work experience in application program development
 • Expert level is required in Visual Basic 6, Classic ASP, COM, COM+, XML, XLST, T-SQL, Stored Procedures, Functions, and Views in SQL Server 2008 RS
 • Strong knowledge of Object Oriented Programming with C#, Visual Studio 2008/2010, SQL Server Management Studio 2008
 • Strong knowledge of development and implementation of ASP.NET and Windows Forms applications
 • Strong abilities in requirements gathering, analysis, and specification procedures
 • Demonstrated proficiency in C#, VB.NET, ASP.NET, IIS is highly preferred
 • Demonstrated proficiency in JavaScript, XML, XSL, HTML, DHTML, and CSS is preferred
 • Demonstrated proficiency in SSIS, SSRS, WCF, and WebServices is highly preferred
 • Proficiency in ADO.NET, TSQL, and Database design is preferred
 • Competent to work at the highest technical level of all phases of applications programming activities
 • Working knowledge of Team Foundation Services 2012 is preferred
 • Demonstrated ability to use discretion and make sound decisions
 • Ability to excel in a collaborative and distributed team environment
 • Ability to work under pressure
 • Ability to effectively communicate with various levels of employees ranging from entry level to senior leadership
 • Ability to manage multiple projects at the same time and shift priorities quickly
 • Proven strong problem-solving skills, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis
 • Excellent written and verbal communication skills
 • Strong aspiration to learn new technologies
 • Proven strong relationship-building and communication skills with team members and business users
 • Ability to maintain confidentiality

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". - All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply. - Candidates must clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
